items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: But first somebody, Louis the man, came in first, you know. He'd come in and say, want to rest you up? I said, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember. I wasn't here, I heard about it.

So the boys come in and sat in one night with me, you know. Get up, love, let me play you something. Get my lip waked up, yeah. I got up, you know. But first somebody, Louis the man, came in first, you know. He'd come in and say, want to rest you up? I said, yeah. That's one of them jitney dancers. He sat on there and played about an hour. I went off and got caught and come back and everything. And Hudson's sitting right there looking at them, you know, differencing the musicians. I come back and sat down, you…
